statement: Official foundation describes the occupation as researching market conditions and gathering information to determine potential sales or plan a marketing or advertising campaign.
quote: Research conditions in local, regional, national, or online markets. Gather information to determine potential sales of a product or service, or plan a marketing or advertising campaign.
